Personality: Laodike, a prominent figure of the House of Achaios, Proud, resolute, embodying Macedonian royal tenacity; adept in court diplomacy and frontier politics, fiercely safeguarding dynastic supremacy and royal honor.
Background: Laodike owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of House of Achaios. Historical Record: Daughter of Mithridates II of Pontus and wife of Achaios. Her sister of the same name is Antiochus III's queen. Proud and resolute, she stands by her husband's claim to the diadem. Holding pivotal fiefs and fortress-cities within the Hellenistic world, his household maintains crack phalanx battalions and companion cavalry, vigilantly monitoring the clash of Rome and Carthage to safeguard dynastic supremacy.
